paragraphs.text: You dart down an alley, turn and head in a completely different direction. Running feet sound behind you. For the first time you feel Emberhead’s cramped, chaotic streets work in your favor. You try to circle round towards the southern road.
Make a Stealth roll. If you succeed, you may check-mark the small box beside the Stealth skill and go to 7. If you fail, go to 170.
